gate.name: request_type
gate.description: Classify the type of work a request asks for into exactly one request-type category.

classes.label: code_generation
classes.description: Write, create, implement, or build code, scripts, functions, or APIs — introducing net-new logic, features, or functionality rather than explaining or fixing existing code.
utterances: add a new endpoint that streams paginated results to the client
implement a feature that exports reports in multiple file formats
write a function that validates nested configuration objects
create a CLI subcommand for scaffolding a new project
build a script that backfills missing records in the database
introduce a plugin hook so extensions can register custom commands
implement retry with exponential backoff for the HTTP client
refactor the component to use the shared utility module
improve performance by rewriting the hot path in the parser
modernize the code to use the newer API
proposal: use the faster implementation in this module
use the new helper function in this module
rewrite this part of the module more efficiently
generate the boilerplate for a new service from the project template
add a background worker that drains jobs from the queue

classes.label: code_understanding
classes.description: Explain, review, debug, fix, or trace existing code, bugs, or stack traces — making sense of how current code behaves rather than designing or building something new.
utterances: explain how the scheduler decides which task to run next
trace the request path through the middleware to find where the header is dropped
review this pull request and summarize the behavior changes
what does this regex in the parser actually match
why does this query return duplicate rows
fix the null pointer in this handler when the session expires
walk me through how authentication tokens are refreshed
this bug report describes a crash when the process starts
the stack trace shows an unhandled exception inside the extension
the log reports an unhandled error with a stack trace
explain what this function returns when the input list is empty
trace the data flow from the API call down to the database layer
figure out which code path triggers this deprecation warning
summarize the behavior changes introduced by this changeset
point out the risky parts in this diff before it is merged

classes.label: technical_design
classes.description: Architect, model, or structure a system, infrastructure, or database, or compare technical trade-offs — designing approaches, contracts, schemas, and proposals before implementation.
utterances: propose a design for splitting the monolith into two services
draft an RFC for the new plugin interface
design the schema for storing audit logs across regions
outline the migration strategy from polling to webhooks
spec the public API contract for the v2 endpoint
compare trade-offs between event sourcing and a transactional outbox
sketch the architecture for a multi-tenant deployment topology
propose adding a new field to the API object
request a new capability in the controller with clear semantics
outline the expected behavior and scope of a proposed feature
proposed API for extensions to query editor state
decompose the component into smaller reusable parts
move the shared logic into a common module
model the data entities and their relationships for the new domain
choose between a queue-based and a request-response integration and justify the trade-offs

classes.label: analytical_reasoning
classes.description: Solve, compute, prove, or reason through math, logic, complex debugging, edge-case analysis, or any problem requiring multi-step technical reasoning.
utterances: compute the worst-case time complexity of this recursive function
solve this recurrence relation and give a closed form
prove that this algorithm is correct for all inputs
reason about whether this algorithm terminates for all inputs
derive the closed form of this summation
calculate the expected number of steps this loop takes
determine whether the two schemes are equivalent
figure out the mathematical invariant that holds across iterations
compute the result of this arithmetic expression
prove or disprove this mathematical statement
work out the probability that this hashing scheme produces a collision
analyze whether this greedy strategy is optimal for the given problem
derive the state transition logic that explains the observed behavior
reason through the edge cases of this recursive function
solve the constraint-satisfaction problem and list the valid assignments

classes.label: writing
classes.description: Draft, edit, rewrite, or translate prose, emails, essays, or documentation — producing or revising human-readable text rather than code.
utterances: update the README quick-start with the new install command
write a user guide explaining the configuration options
translate the error messages in the UI to Spanish
document the release process in the contributor handbook
rewrite the API reference examples to match the current schema
draft an announcement email for the upcoming release
add a troubleshooting section to the setup page
fix a typo in the documentation
improve the wording of this error message
edit the release notes to reflect the new features and fixes
rewrite the onboarding guide so new contributors can follow it step by step
draft a short blog post announcing the deprecation timeline
write a quick reference card for the most commonly used commands
correct the grammar in the contributor guidelines
write an FAQ section answering the most common setup questions

classes.label: factual_lookup
classes.description: Direct factual questions, definitions, or simple attributes — asking what something is, whether it is supported or compatible, or for a simple list or lookup.
utterances: is this configuration option supported in the latest release
which minimum runtime version does this package require
what is the definition of this setting
is this library compatible with the newer platform version
clarify when this change takes effect
where is this option documented
how do I register a tool in the extension
is it possible to create a terminal in this context
list the available configuration options
which platforms are supported
what does this configuration flag control
when was this feature introduced and in which release
how many replicas does the default deployment run
which endpoint serves the health check
what is the default value of this timeout setting

classes.label: general
classes.description: Catch-all for configuration, general announcements, admin tasks, greetings, or anything that does not clearly fit another category.
utterances: update the CI pipeline to run tests on the new branch
add a workflow that publishes the package on tagged releases
tweak the linter configuration to ignore generated files
bump the dependency to the latest patch release
refresh the CODEOWNERS file with the new team
announce the upcoming maintenance window to the team
reorder the checklist items in the issue template
track the rollout status of this feature across environments
improve the onboarding flow for first-run users
finalize the existing API for wider adoption
deprecate the existing API surface
upgrade the bundled dependency to the latest version
decide on the release process for this component
set up repository automation for assigning reviewers to new pull requests
clean up stale labels and milestones across the issue tracker
